\section[\texorpdfstring{\fa{رویداد} (ruydâd)}{رویداد (ruydâd)}]{\fa{رویداد} (ruydâd) — an event}

\label{lesson:FA-C314-ruydad}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Persian for a summary, then the Persian for to summarise.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \fa{رویداد}}
\textbf{\fa{رویداد}} (\emph{ruydâd}) — \textquotedblleft{}an event\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\fa{جشنواره} \fa{فیلم} \fa{مهمترین} \fa{رویداد} \fa{فرهنگی} \fa{شهر} \fa{است}.
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{Jashnvâre-ye film mohemtarin ruydâd-e farhangi-ye shahr ast.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
The film festival is the most important cultural event in the city.
\end{quote}

A modern word, built on \emph{ruy dâdan} \textquotedblleft{}to occur\textquotedblright{}. Plural \emph{ruydâd-hâ}.

\begin{cousinweb}
\emph{ruydâd} is derived from \emph{ruy dâdan} \textquotedblleft{}to occur\textquotedblright{} (EtymDB): \emph{ruy} \textquotedblleft{}face\textquotedblright{} with \emph{dâd}, the past stem of \emph{dâdan} \textquotedblleft{}to give\textquotedblright{}. Both parts are native Persian.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for telling, explaining and describing at B1.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{ruydâd}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{ruydâd}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} a sentence of your own with \emph{ruydâd}
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Persian for a summary, then the Persian for to summarise, then say \emph{ruydâd} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
What does \fa{رویداد} mean? (\textquotedblleft{}An event\textquotedblright{}.) Say it once more.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[\texorpdfstring{\fa{واقعه} (vâqe'e)}{واقعه (vâqe'e)}]{\fa{واقعه} (vâqe'e) — an incident, an occurrence}

\label{lesson:FA-C314-vaqee}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Persian for to summarise, then the Persian for an event.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \fa{واقعه}}
\textbf{\fa{واقعه}} (\emph{vâqe'e}) — \textquotedblleft{}an incident, an occurrence\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\fa{این} \fa{واقعه} \fa{در} \fa{یک} \fa{شب} \fa{سرد} \fa{اتفاق} \fa{افتاد}.
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{In vâqe'e dar yek shab-e sard ettefâq oftâd.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
This incident happened on a cold night.
\end{quote}

Formal; broken plural \emph{vaqâye'}. Often for serious or historic events.

\begin{cousinweb}
\emph{vâqe'e} is borrowed from Arabic \emph{wāqi'a}, \textquotedblleft{}event, incident\textquotedblright{} (EtymDB).
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for telling, explaining and describing at B1.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{vâqe'e}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{vâqe'e}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} a sentence of your own with \emph{vâqe'e}
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Persian for to summarise, then the Persian for an event, then say \emph{vâqe'e} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
What does \fa{واقعه} mean? (\textquotedblleft{}An incident, an occurrence\textquotedblright{}.) Say it once more.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[\texorpdfstring{\fa{برگزار} \fa{شدن} (bargozâr shodan)}{برگزار شدن (bargozâr shodan)}]{\fa{برگزار} \fa{شدن} (bargozâr shodan) — to be held}

\label{lesson:FA-C314-bargozar-shodan}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Persian for an event, then the Persian for an incident.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \fa{برگزار} \fa{شدن}}
\textbf{\fa{برگزار} \fa{شدن}} (\emph{bargozâr shodan}) — \textquotedblleft{}to be held\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\fa{جلسه} \fa{در} \fa{سالن} \fa{بزرگ} \fa{مدرسه} \fa{برگزار} \fa{شد}.
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{Jalase dar sâlon-e bozorg-e madrese bargozâr shod.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
The meeting was held in the big hall of the school.
\end{quote}

For organised events. Present \emph{bargozâr mishavad}.

\begin{cousinweb}
\emph{bargozâr} \textquotedblleft{}carried out\textquotedblright{} joins \emph{bar} \textquotedblleft{}up, on\textquotedblright{} and the native stem \emph{gozâr-} \textquotedblleft{}to set out\textquotedblright{}; \emph{shodan} \textquotedblleft{}to become\textquotedblright{} is inherited Persian. EtymDB lists no entry.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for telling, explaining and describing at B1.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{bargozâr shodan}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{bargozâr shodan}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} a sentence of your own with \emph{bargozâr shodan}
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Persian for an event, then the Persian for an incident, then say \emph{bargozâr shodan} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
What does \fa{برگزار} \fa{شدن} mean? (\textquotedblleft{}To be held\textquotedblright{}.) Say it once more.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[\texorpdfstring{\fa{برگزار} \fa{کردن} (bargozâr kardan)}{برگزار کردن (bargozâr kardan)}]{\fa{برگزار} \fa{کردن} (bargozâr kardan) — to hold, to organise (an event)}

\label{lesson:FA-C314-bargozar-kardan}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Persian for an incident, then the Persian for to be held.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \fa{برگزار} \fa{کردن}}
\textbf{\fa{برگزار} \fa{کردن}} (\emph{bargozâr kardan}) — \textquotedblleft{}to hold, to organise (an event)\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\fa{دانشگاه} \fa{هر} \fa{سال} \fa{یک} \fa{جشنواره} \fa{برگزار} \fa{میکند}.
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{Dâneshgâh har sâl yek jashnvâre bargozâr mikonad.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
The university holds a festival every year.
\end{quote}

Present \emph{bargozâr mikonad}. The event takes \emph{râ} when it is definite.

\begin{cousinweb}
\emph{bargozâr kardan} joins the native \emph{bargozâr} \textquotedblleft{}carried out\textquotedblright{} (\emph{bar} + \emph{gozâr-}) with \emph{kardan} \textquotedblleft{}to do\textquotedblright{}, inherited Persian.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for telling, explaining and describing at B1.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright

  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{bargozâr kardan}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} a sentence of your own with \emph{bargozâr kardan}
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Persian for an incident, then the Persian for to be held, then say \emph{bargozâr kardan} again
\end{itemize}

\section[\texorpdfstring{\fa{شرکت} \fa{کردن} (sherkat kardan)}{شرکت کردن (sherkat kardan)}]{\fa{شرکت} \fa{کردن} (sherkat kardan) — to take part, to participate}

\label{lesson:FA-C314-sherkat-kardan}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Persian for to be held, then the Persian for to hold.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \fa{شرکت} \fa{کردن}}
\textbf{\fa{شرکت} \fa{کردن}} (\emph{sherkat kardan}) — \textquotedblleft{}to take part, to participate\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\fa{صد} \fa{نفر} \fa{در} \fa{مسابقه} \fa{شرکت} \fa{کردند}.
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{Sad nafar dar mosâbeqe sherkat kardand.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
A hundred people took part in the competition.
\end{quote}

With \emph{dar}: \emph{dar jalase sherkat kard}. The noun \emph{sherkat} alone is \textquotedblleft{}a company\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{cousinweb}
\emph{sherkat} is borrowed from Arabic \emph{shirka} (EtymDB lists the Arabic word), usually glossed \textquotedblleft{}partnership, sharing\textquotedblright{}. \emph{kardan} \textquotedblleft{}to do\textquotedblright{} is inherited Persian.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for telling, explaining and describing at B1.
\end{grammarlens}
